properties.summary: Incident Type: RAILROAD - NRC Report ID: 1437849 - Medium Affected: RAIL REPORT (N/A) - Suspected Responsible Party: CONRAIL CONSOLIDATED
properties.content:
Report Details
NRC Report ID: 1437849
Incident Time: 2025-07-01 19:45:00
Nearest City: Newark, NJ
Location: OAK ISLAND RAILYARD
Incident Type: RAILROAD
Material: OIL: DIESEL
Medium Affected: RAIL REPORT (N/A)
Suspected Responsible Party: CONRAIL CONSOLIDATED
SkyTruth Analysis
Lat/Long: 40.709824, -74.143226 (Approximated from establishment)
Reported Spill Volume: 450 gallon
Report Description///THIS IS AN UPDATE TO NRC REPORT 1435771/// UPDATED INFO IS AS FOLLOWS: THE RELEASE WAS FROM AN ENGINE. THE ENGINE STRUCK A BOLT THAT WAS STICKING OUT OF A RETARDER, DUE TO EQUIPMENT FAILURE, WHICH CAUSED THE RELEASE. ENGINE NUMBER IS CSX4406. ENGINE WAS TRAVELING WEST WHICH CAUSED A RUPTURE IN THE DIESEL TANK. IT THEN TRAVELED 4,000 FEET WEST ON THE TRACK, REVERSED DIRECTION AND THEN WENT 2,000 FEET EAST BACK ON THE SAME TRACK. AT THIS TIME THEY NOTICED A RELEASE FROM THE ENGINE, APPLIED A PATCH AND CONTACTED EMERGENCY CREWS. IT WAS DETERMINED THAT ONLY 450 GALLONS OF DIESEL WAS RELEASED. 2 LOCOMOTIVES, AND 0 CARS WERE ON THE TRAIN. INCIDENT DID NOT OCCUR AT A GRADE CROSSING. THE MILEPOST/SUBDIVISION IS STILL UNKNOWN. CLEAN UP IS UNDERWAY. ALL IMPACTED SOIL WILL BE EXCAVATED. THE ORIGINAL REPORTED INFO IS AS FOLLOWS: THE CALLER REPORTED THAT A RAILCAR ON A FREIGHT TRAIN STRUCK A RETARDER, WHICH CREATED A HOLE IN THE CAR. THIS RESULTED IN THE RELEASE OF AN UNKNOWN AMOUNT OF DIESEL FUEL (UP TO 3,000 GALLONS) ONTO BALLAST AND SOIL. NO WATERWAYS OR STORM DRAINS WERE AFFECTED. THE CAUSE OF THE RAILCAR STRIKING THE RETARDER IS UNKNOWN.

PAST COLLEGE POLICY HAS BEEN TO DISCHARGE NOTHING, AND TO COLLECT ALL WASTES TO AN AUTHORIZED EPA WASTE COLLECTOR.
